lesson.title: you've said it a thousand times
lesson.hook: you've said it a thousand times — at a table, at a funeral

title: amen means yes
hook: it's not the end of the prayer. it's the opposite.
cast: shot 5: mourners of mixed ages; today: a Filipino family in Manila, lola at the centre.
